phase: Accounting Empirical Recovery / F8 Phase A — Total Other Accounts Coverage Audit

sector_decomposition_summary.interpretation: The incomplete controls arise because the S121 F81/F89 component series needed to form RMD F=S12-S121 and the BNR component rows are not published in the tested aggregate layer. This is missing component coverage, not an F8=F81+F89 contradiction.

interpretation: BNR has a non-zero aggregate F8 asset position/flow and zero aggregate F8 liabilities in the tested 2025 controls.
No bilateral zero is inferred in Phase A.

Because F8 positions are claims/liabilities, a stock-only zero-liability partition scenario could be tested later, but only after component-bilateral recovery and exact-rank analysis; zero aggregate flows are never converted to bilateral zeros.

scientific_interpretation: The direct QSA source does not publish any tested bilateral total-F8 holder-by-issuer cell for Romania in W2/W1 orientations.
The total instrument is nevertheless strongly validated at aggregate level: every total-economy control satisfies F8=F81+F89 within the 0.1 million RON tolerance.

F89 is quantitatively material. For example, at 2025-Q4 W0 assets F89 is 550026.68 million RON versus F81 601224.52 million RON; treating trade credit F81 as total F8 would omit nearly half the instrument.

The next recovery step should test whether bilateral F81 and F89 are published even though bilateral total F8 is not. If both subcomponents are available for a cell, total F8 can be derived exactly as their sum.
